name: Awas Sahayta Yojana for 100% Hearing and Visually Impaired Disabled Students in Special Trades of Industrial Training Institutes
benefit:
- Housing assistance up to ₹4,000/- per student per month for food and accommodation is available, provided the student is studying outside their home residence at an Industrial Training Institute.
- Housing assistance of ₹2,000/- per month per student for food and other expenses only is available, if the student receives hostel facility provided by the Principal of the Industrial Training Institu
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a student. - The applicant must be 100% visually or hearing-impaired. - The applicant must be admitted to an Industrial Training Institute. - The applicant must not have received admission into any Government Hostel. - The applicant must not have received assistance from any Government Department. ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** The applicant must present a certificate or declaration from the guardian stating that the guardian does not have an residential address at the same location or division where the Industrial Training Institute of regular study is situated.
